"Lizzi McBeth's" Visual Tarot Course Intro
Clip Objective: Introduce the instructor ("Lizzi McBeth" - the AI will generate a person based on the description) and welcome students to the course, highlighting the focus on intuition.

Prompt (to be entered into the tool):

[SCENE DETAILS]: A bright, clean, and inviting indoor space. The background is slightly blurred, suggesting a comfortable and aesthetically pleasing environment, perhaps with soft natural light coming from a side.

[SUBJECT DETAILS + ENVIRONMENT]: A charismatic woman, appearing to be in her late 30s or early 40s, with a warm and confident smile. She is looking directly at the camera, establishing a personal connection. She is wearing professional yet approachable attire. Subtle elements related to learning or intuition (like a beautifully illustrated book or a smooth stone) could be softly visible in the blurred background.

[ACTION]: The woman is speaking directly to the viewer with engaging facial expressions. She makes subtle, natural hand gestures as she talks.

[SHOT STYLE + DETAILS]: Medium close-up shot, steady camera. The framing should focus on her face and upper body, emphasizing her welcoming demeanor. Shallow depth of field to keep the focus on her.

[LIGHTING]: Soft, flattering frontal or slightly side lighting. Warm color temperature to create an inviting atmosphere.

[SOUND DESCRIPTION]: Clean, clear audio of a female voice. Gentle, encouraging background music starts subtly and remains low during the dialogue.

[AUDIO]: Dialogue (to be spoken in Spanish): "Female voice (warm, engaging, confident tone): Hola, soy Lizzi McBeth, bienvenidas al curso de Tarot Visual, donde aprenderan a Leer las Cartas con tu Intuición, No de Memoria."

[FILM STYLE]: Professional, high visual quality, inviting, clear focus on the presenter. Emphasize connection and approachability
